environment.description: Same application deployed on Tomcat 9.0.65 in ECS Fargate. Database connectivity routed through AWS RDS Proxy (PostgreSQL engine) with the RDS Proxy configured using IAM authentication mode. The RDS instance has a custom parameter group with 'pgaudit.log=all' and critically, the PostgreSQL role used by RDS Proxy has been created with the attribute NOSUPERUSER and connected through pg_hba.conf entry specifying 'hostssl all app_readonly 10.0.0.0/16 scram-sha-256'. The role 'app_readonly' is granted ONLY: GRANT SELECT ON user_profiles TO app_readonly; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_readonly; No other table grants exist. Additionally, the RDS instance has the 'log_statement=all' parameter and a CloudWatch subscription filter triggers a Lambda that invokes SNS on any query containing UNION, information_schema, pg_catalog, or pg_tables (alerting only, not blocking). The ECS task role has no RDS IAM connect permission for any role other than app_readonly via resource-level IAM policy: arn:aws:rds-db:*:*:dbuser:*/app_readonly.

config.db_role_grants: SELECT ON user_profiles ONLY, USAGE ON SCHEMA public
config.rds_proxy_auth: IAM authentication, pinned to app_readonly role
config.monitoring: CloudWatch subscription filter on UNION/information_schema/pg_catalog keywords -> SNS alert
config.network: private subnet, security group allows 5432 from ECS SG only
